title: Commerce Connector Data Exchange (scheduled and real-time integrations)
summary: Admin-configured multi-step exchanges (API, SFTP, Blob, Znode Import) that run on a schedule or on an event or callback trigger, with a Credential Vault. A custom processor covers transformations the mapper cannot express. Replaces the legacy ERP connector.
when_to_use: pull ERP data on a schedule
push an order or account change to an ERP when it happens
real-time stock via callback with the documented limits
not_for: arbitrary jobs with no data movement
new work on the legacy ERP connector
limitations: No dead-letter queue or retry UI
Imports never delete and write Draft data: publish afterwards
No log viewer for custom processors
platform_change_if: retry and dead-letter handling inside the module

unverified: behaviour on the customer's Znode version
custom processors in multi-step exchanges (KB articles disagree)
